articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems today announced the ACS37200, a galvanically isolated current sensor that provides a breakthrough solution to the efficiency and power density challenges in high-current applications
articles.title: Allegro Sets New Standard for Efficiency in High-Power Systems with Ultra-Low-Loss Isolated Current Sensor

articles.summary: Allegro expands its Power-Thru™ portfolio with the AHV85003/AHV85043 chipset, a complete family of self-powered, noise-eliminating SiC gate drivers for 800V systems.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Simplifies SiC Power Design for AI Data Centers and EVs with Expanded Power-Thru™ Gate Driver Portfolio
